Stop._comment: Block exit when egregore has active work items. Bounded: after EGREGORE_STOP_MAX_STALLS blocks with no manifest change the hook approves the stop, so a session that cannot advance the pipeline does not re-inject forever.

SessionStart._comment: Resume egregore orchestration on session start. Excludes fork and compact, which continue a conversation that already carries this banner. Excludes clear as well, a choice that predates the fork source and is left as found.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Inject orchestration-resume context when user interrupts an active egregore session
